responsibility: Defines the lowering visitor for items contained in impl blocks, covering both inherent and trait impl members. It translates impl methods, associated constants, and type aliases into HIR impl-item forms, lowers their function signatures, self parameters, generic parameters, patterns, types, bodies, and attributes, and records parent-child, DefId, HirId, and source-location mappings under the owning impl block. This file’s role is specifically associated-item lowering inside impls, distinct from lowering whole impl blocks or top-level items.
